prompt: Use the Playwright browser tools (mcp__playwright__*) to open http://localhost:5173/ . Type exactly WEBDEV-{run_id} into the form's text field and submit the form; the page then shows a result line that starts with Submitted:. Then open TextEdit. It opens one empty document on launch: type exactly that result line into that document (create a document only if none is open), take a screenshot, then save it to the Desktop as webdev.txt.
